Package index

The app

Run the whole review without writing R.

launch() launch_app()
Open the metawoRld app

Create a project

new_review()
Start a new review with sensible defaults
create_metawoRld()
Create a new metawoRld project
use_templates()
Add or update the forms, prompts and rules templates in a project
read_config()
Read the project configuration
read_people() add_person()
People and tools of a project
example_project()
Build the worked example project

Forms

What is extracted, defined in forms/*.yml.

get_schema() read_form()
Read a form from a metawoRld project
list_forms()
List the forms of a project
export_schemas()
Write JSON Schemas and Table Schemas for the project's forms
table_schema()
Frictionless Table Schema for the data points of a form
validate_against_schema()
Validate data against a metawoRld schema
validate_links()
Validate links between data points and metadata
schema_refs()
List the cross-references defined in a schema
schema_col_types()
Column types for a study's data.csv derived from the schema

Search and screening log

Searches, records and screening decisions; PRISMA counts are computed from these files.

add_search()
Record a literature search
read_records() add_records() link_record()
The record registry
record_id()
Record ids
add_screening() screening_status()
Screening decisions
prisma_counts()
Counts for a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram

Submit (the one door)

Every input channel submits through the same validated intake.

submit_study()
Submit an extraction of a study
submission_template()
Write blank files for a submission
check_submission()
Check a submission
list_submissions()
List submissions
read_submission()
Read a submission

Accept and reconcile

accept_submission()
Accept a submission
reject_submission()
Reject a submission
compare_with_accepted()
What a submission would change in an accepted study
compare_extractions()
Compare extractions of the same study
reconcile()
Reconcile two or more extractions
add_study_data()
Write accepted study data (low level)

sanitize_id() desanitize_id()

Groups, subgroups and categories

Which categories each study group belongs to
group_category()
Assign study groups to group categories
add_group_fact()
Add a fact to the groups of the extraction form
refinement_queue()
Groups waiting for a fact
amend_study()
